static_pool_loading_repair.fairness: Restore the registered B1 common seven-skill initial-pool condition, exactly shared with B2/B3/B4. No final evaluation had started.

static_pool_loading_repair.before_fix_regression: Explicit seven-skill static pool is silently replaced by default six; regression reproduced.
